question: What is the capital city of Japan?
What is the chemical symbol for sodium?
Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
Who wrote the novel Pride and Prejudice?
What is the process by which plants use light to make sugars called?
What is a polygon with exactly three sides called?
At standard atmospheric pressure, what is the freezing point of pure water in degrees Celsius?

A scheduling guide says Room A can host a meeting only if it has at least 8 seats and a projector. Room B needs at least 12 seats and a video link. A session has 9 people, needs a projector, and does not need a video link. Which room meets the session's stated needs?
Which gas makes up the largest share of Earth's dry atmosphere?
What is the official language of Brazil?
An archive labels items by century and then by material. A paper letter dated 1895 must be filed under which century-and-material label?
A greenhouse guide says orchids need both warmth and humidity. Room A is warm and humid, Room B is warm and dry, and Room C is cool and humid. Which room meets both requirements?
Robotics meets on Tuesday. Astronomy meets two days after Robotics, and Debate meets the day after Astronomy. On which day does Debate meet?

A visitor needs one badge that permits entry to both a laboratory and a lecture room. Blue permits laboratory entry only, red permits lecture-room entry only, and green permits both. Which badge should the visitor use?
The Oak train departs at 08:10 and the Pine train at 08:25. Check-in closes 10 minutes before departure. A passenger arrives at 08:12. Which train can the passenger still check in for?
A device's manual says a yellow port carries video and a white port carries audio. A display needs both signals. Which two ports are required?

A wildlife guide gives these conditions: robins call within one hour of sunrise in woodland; kingfishers call near water during daylight; owls call after dark. A recording was made 30 minutes before sunrise in woodland away from water. Which bird best matches both time and location?
A rare-book loan requires membership, but books marked Reference must stay inside the library. Lee is a member and requests a Reference book. Can Lee take it home?
A museum puts ancient coins in Hall 2. Hall 2 is open only on weekdays, and today is Thursday. Can a visitor see the coins today?
A plant species needs acidic soil and shade. Plot A is acidic and shaded; Plot B is acidic and sunny; Plot C is alkaline and shaded. Which plot qualifies?

A research dataset is accepted only if it was collected after 2021, is anonymized, has at least 1,000 rows, and has documented participant consent. Which dataset qualifies? A: 2022, anonymized, 1,200 rows, consent documented. B: 2022, anonymized, 1,200 rows, no consent record. C: 2020, anonymized, 1,500 rows, consent documented. D: 2023, identifiable, 2,000 rows, consent documented.

A microscopy room requires a valid blue or green laboratory badge, a completed safety briefing, and arrival after 13:00. Which visitor qualifies? Dana: valid green badge, briefing completed, arrives 14:10. Ravi: expired blue badge, briefing completed, arrives 14:30. Noor: valid red badge, briefing completed, arrives 15:00. Lee: valid blue badge, briefing incomplete, arrives 14:00.

A training grant requires completion of Course A, a score of at least 80%, and enrollment before Friday. Which applicant qualifies? Mira: Course A complete, 86%, enrolled Thursday. Noor: Course A complete, 92%, enrolled Saturday. Lee: Course A incomplete, 95%, enrolled Wednesday. Ravi: Course A complete, 79%, enrolled Monday.

A pass policy says Green allows every session; Blue allows workshops and talks after noon but not morning talks; Red allows talks only. Sam has a Blue pass and wants to attend a 10:00 talk and a 14:00 workshop. Can Sam attend both?

A travel policy grants a meal voucher for a delay longer than 90 minutes, a hotel voucher for a missed connection, and a cancellation credit only if the flight is cancelled. Flight X was delayed 120 minutes, the passenger missed a connection, and the flight was not cancelled. Which benefits apply?

Packages are sent to Priority Gate 4 only if they are North-bound, marked Express, marked Fragile, and arrive before 16:00. Which package should be sent to Gate 4? A: North, Express, Fragile, 15:40. B: North, Express, Regular, 15:30. C: South, Express, Fragile, 15:20. D: North, Standard, Fragile, 15:10.

A plant grows only if soil is acidic, the plot is shaded, and it receives water every week. Plot A is acidic, shaded, and watered weekly. Plot B is acidic and shaded but watered monthly. Plot C is alkaline, shaded, and watered weekly. Plot D is acidic, sunny, and watered weekly. Which plot qualifies?

A library allows rare-book loans only to members. Any book marked Reference must remain inside the building, even for members. Lee is a member and requests a rare book marked Reference. May Lee take it home?

A device's indicator is blue only if battery is above 50%, the network is connected, and power-saving mode is off. Its battery is 72%, the network is connected, and power-saving mode is on. Should the indicator be blue?

A grant project must be submitted after 2021, be no more than five pages, cost at most $20,000, and have a faculty sponsor. Which proposal qualifies? A: 2022, 5 pages, $19,000, sponsor yes. B: 2023, 6 pages, $18,000, sponsor yes. C: 2020, 4 pages, $15,000, sponsor yes. D: 2022, 4 pages, $20,500, sponsor yes.
A student has 37 pencils and receives 25 more. How many pencils does the student have now?
What is 96 divided by 8?
What is 20% of 50?
There are 7 packs with 6 cards in each pack. How many cards are there altogether?
Convert 2.5 meters to centimeters. How many centimeters is that?
A square has side length 9 cm. What is its perimeter in centimeters?
What is three-quarters of 20?
A box contains 18 blocks and 7 are removed. How many blocks remain?
Convert 45 minutes to hours. Give the answer in hours.
Convert 1.2 kilograms to grams.
A student buys 4 notebooks at $3 each and 2 pens at $1.50 each. What is the total cost in dollars?
A 100-page book is read at 20 pages per day for 3 days. How many pages remain unread?
A tank starts with 200 liters. A leak removes 12 liters per hour for 5 hours, with no water added. How many liters remain?
There are 3 boxes with 8 oranges each and 2 boxes with 5 apples each. How many pieces of fruit are there in total?
A jacket costs $60 and has a 15% discount. What is the price after the discount, before tax?
A worker earns $14 per hour for 6 hours and then pays a $10 fee. How much money remains from that shift's earnings?
A rectangle is 12 meters long and its width is half its length. What is its perimeter in meters?
A recipe uses 300 grams of flour for 4 servings. At the same rate, how many grams are needed for 10 servings?
A player scores 12, 18, and 24 points in three games. What is the average points per game?
A bus has 35 passengers. At a stop, 12 leave and 8 board. How many passengers are on the bus afterward?
A factory makes 450 toys per hour, runs 6 hours per day, and operates 4 days per week. At this rate, how many toys does it make in one week?
A tank contains 900 liters. A leak removes 18 liters per hour while a pump adds 7 liters per hour. After 10 hours, how many liters remain?
A product costs $80. It receives a 25% discount, then 8% sales tax is applied to the discounted price. What is the final price in dollars?

A warehouse has 640 units. It ships three-eighths of its stock on Monday, then ships 25% of the remaining stock on Tuesday. On Wednesday, 18 units still in stock are found damaged and removed. How many undamaged units remain?
A farm has 12 cows producing 5 liters of milk each per day and 8 goats producing 2 liters each per day. How many liters are produced in 7 days?
A worker earns $22 per hour for 35 hours. If 12% of gross weekly earnings is deducted as tax, what is the net weekly pay in dollars?
A train travels at 72 miles per hour for 2.5 hours and then at 54 miles per hour for 1.5 hours. What total distance does it travel?
A fruit vendor has 200 kg of watermelons. The vendor sells 60% in the morning, donates one-quarter of the remaining stock, and then sells 25 kg in the afternoon. How many kilograms remain?
A person has $240. They spend three-eighths on equipment, then spend 20% of the remaining amount on books, and finally receive an $18 refund. How much money do they have at the end?
A charity has 480 bottles. It sends 35% to a school, then sends half of the remaining bottles to a clinic. How many bottles remain after both deliveries?
What number comes next in the sequence 4, 7, 10, 13, ...?
All mammals in a study breathe air. A whale is a mammal. Under the stated rule, does the whale breathe air?
Three cards—red, blue, and green—are in a row. Blue is immediately to the right of red, and red is to the left of green. What is the left-to-right order?
A code's first character is chosen from A or E and its second character from 1 or 2. How many different two-character codes are possible?
A lamp turns on whenever its button is pressed. The button is pressed. Under this rule, what happens to the lamp?
If today is Tuesday, what day is tomorrow?
Every lab worker in a building has an ID badge. Mina is a lab worker in that building. Does Mina have an ID badge?
Three doors are labelled North, South, and East. The South door is the only door that opens toward the garden. Which door opens toward the garden?
What letter comes next in the sequence B, D, F, H, ...?
If a box is locked, a key is needed to open it. The box is locked. Is a key needed under this rule?
Four runners finish in this order: Dev finishes before Ana, Ana before Ben, and Ben before Cara. Who finishes second?
Four talks are ordered with Design before Robotics, Robotics before AI, and AI before Ethics. Which talk is third?
Priya is ahead of Mira in a queue, Mira is ahead of Niko, and Omar is behind Niko. Who must be first among these four people?
A three-digit code uses 2, 4, and 6 exactly once. The first digit is not 2, the last digit is not 6, and the middle digit is greater than the first. What is the code?
A meeting is scheduled one day before its deadline. The deadline is Wednesday, and the meeting must be on Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday. On which day is the meeting?
Every registered member has a badge. Rina has a badge. Does this information prove that Rina is a registered member?
If P implies Q and Q implies R, and P is true, what must be true about R?
A number is 1, 2, or 3. Exactly two statements are true: A says the number is even; B says it is greater than 2; C says it equals 2. What is the number?
A report is published only if the editor approves it and fact-checking passes. The editor approved it, but fact-checking failed. Is publication guaranteed by the rules?
Five people each shake hands with every other person exactly once. How many handshakes take place?
A three-digit code uses digits 1, 2, and 3 exactly once. The code is greater than 220 and odd, digit 2 appears before digit 1, and digit 3 is not first. What is the code?

Three boxes are labelled Apples, Oranges, and Mixed, but every label is wrong. Each box contains either only apples, only oranges, or a mix. You draw an apple from the box labelled Mixed. What is actually in the box labelled Oranges?
Four tasks A, B, C, and D occupy four consecutive slots. C is before B, D immediately follows C, A is before B but is not first, and D is not last. What is the order?
Five tasks A, B, C, D, and E must be placed in order. E occurs before C; B immediately follows E; C occurs before A; and A occurs before D. What is the complete order?

Five participants—Ada, Ben, Chen, Devi, and Eli—sit in a row. Ada sits immediately to the left of Ben. Chen sits somewhere to the right of Ben. Eli is at an end, and Devi sits immediately to the right of Eli. What is the left-to-right order?
P, Q, R, and S are distinct numbers 1, 2, 3, and 4 in some order. S=4, R=P+1, and Q=P+2. What is the ordered tuple (P, Q, R, S)?
A lock code uses digits 1, 2, 3, and 4 exactly once. Digit 3 is immediately after digit 1, digit 4 is before digit 1, and digit 2 is after digit 3. What is the code?
A number is chosen from 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5. Exactly two statements are true: A says the number is greater than 2; B says it is odd; C says it equals 3. What is the number?
Tasks A, B, C, D, and E must be ordered. A must precede C; B must precede C; C must precede D; E must precede D; B must precede A; and E must occur after C. What is the order?

A key is in exactly one of Red, Blue, or Green boxes. Red's label says 'The key is in Red'; Blue's says 'The key is not in Red'; Green's says 'The key is in Blue'. Exactly two labels are true. Which box contains the key?
A library report lists visitors as follows: Monday 42, Tuesday 55, Wednesday 49. On which day were there the most visitors?
A battery test reports that Device A lasts 6 hours and Device B lasts 8 hours. How many hours longer does B last than A?
A shop sold 18 apples, 12 pears, and 15 oranges. Which fruit had the highest number sold?
A travel report says the North route is 12 km and the South route is 9 km. Which route is shorter?
A recycling report recorded 14 kg of glass, 22 kg of paper, and 8 kg of metal. Which material had the greatest collected weight?
Class A has 24 students and Class B has 27 students. How many more students are in Class B?
A clinic's average wait was 12 minutes in the morning and 7 minutes in the afternoon. During which period was the wait shorter?
In a survey, 40 people preferred tea, 25 preferred coffee, and 15 preferred juice. Which drink was most popular?
Plan A costs $12 per month and Plan B costs $15 per month. Which plan is cheaper?
A plant-growth record shows Plant A reached 14 cm and Plant B reached 11 cm. How much taller was Plant A?
A shop sold 20 notebooks on Monday, 25 on Tuesday, and 15 on Wednesday. The target was 50 notebooks over those three days. By how many notebooks did total sales exceed the target?
A project was 40% complete on Monday and 70% complete on Friday. The project contains 240 tasks in total. How many additional tasks were completed between Monday and Friday?
A website had 200 visitors and 30% clicked a link. How many visitors did not click the link?
A score report gives Team A 12 points, Team B 15 points, and Team C 9 points. How many points did Teams A and C together score in excess of Team B?
Routes A, B, and C take 18, 25, and 20 minutes. A shortcut reduces route B's time by 30%. After the shortcut, how much faster is B than the fastest of the other two routes?
A household budget lists rent at $900, groceries at $280, and travel at $120. How much greater is rent than the combined grocery and travel costs?
Survey X had 60 approvals from 100 respondents. Survey Y had 45 approvals from 75 respondents. What is the difference between their approval rates, in percentage points?
Device A had 4 defective units out of 80; Device B had 8 defective units out of 100. By how many percentage points is B's defect rate higher than A's?
A library received 50 books: 18 fiction, 12 science, and the rest history. How many history books arrived?
A runner recorded 5,000, 7,000, 6,000, and 8,000 steps over four days. What was the average daily step count?

A shop report compares net revenue after promotions. Red sold 40 units at $3 each and received a $20 fixed rebate on the total. Blue sold 25 units at $5 each with a 5% discount on total sales. Green sold 30 units at $4 each with a 15% discount on total sales. Which product generated the highest net revenue?
A building used 120 kWh of energy before an improvement and 96 kWh afterward. What percentage reduction in energy use did the improvement achieve?
Survey A had 40 positive responses out of 80 people; Survey B had 54 positive responses out of 90 people. Which survey had the higher positive-response rate, and by how many percentage points?
A team has 40 tasks. It completes three-fifths of them, then completes one-quarter of the tasks still remaining. How many tasks remain unfinished?

A project plan is eligible only if it costs at most $100 and takes at most 4 days. Plan A costs $80 and takes 6 days; Plan B costs $120 and takes 3 days; Plan C costs $95 and takes 4 days. Which plan is eligible?
Quality checks report: Device A passes 18 of 20 tests, Device B passes 27 of 30, and Device C passes 42 of 50. Which device or devices have the highest pass rate?
Three production lines report output per hour: A produces 120 units in 4 hours, B produces 150 in 5 hours, and C produces 84 in 3 hours. Which line or lines have the highest hourly productivity?
A project has a $5,000 budget. Equipment uses 35% of the budget and staffing costs another $1,200. If all other funds remain available for travel, how many dollars remain for travel?
Quarterly revenue was $12,000 in Q1 and $19,500 in Q4. What was the percentage increase from Q1 to Q4?

A company reports premium-user shares: Branch A has 240 users and 15% premium; Branch B has 180 users and 20% premium; Branch C has 300 users and 10% premium. Which branch or branches have the most premium users?
